Nina: RFC follow-up: propose unifying actor surface for org/project API keys + service principals. Goals: default-deny, explicit role bindings, ephemeral delegated tokens for services. PTAL @Sam @Alex
Sam: overall 👍. biggest risk is migration churn and spike in 401s. need monitoring plan.
Alex: concerned about added latency if we run policy evals synchronously for every call. caching or local evaluation important. :thinking_face:
Jorge: migration idea: run a shadow-mapping layer that logs decisions without enforcing for 30 days. then flip enforcement per-org. reduces blast radius.
Priya: agree. also want a console bulk-remap tool (CSV import) and an opt-in migration banner for org admins. email cadence for enterprise customers.
Nina: proposed rollout (high level):
1) ship policy-schema-v2 (explicit bindings + constraints)
2) token-exchange endpoint: svc-principal -> short-lived bearer tokens (aud scoped)
3) proxy shim that shadow-maps legacy api-keys -> role ids (no enforcement)
4) feature-flagged canary enforcement per org
Code snippet for auth flow (pseudocode):
```
// auth hot path
if (hdr.startsWith("svc-")) {
  token = tokenExchange(hdr)
  ok = rbac.check(token.actor, res, act)
} else {
  // legacy api-key path (shadow)
  role = shadowMap.lookup(apiKey)
  ok = rbac.check(role, res, act)
}
```
Alex: caching recommendation: cache rbac.check((actor|role), resourcePrefix, action) with ~30s TTL; use local LRU per-process and a fail-open/stale-while-revalidate mode. token-exchange should hit a local token-service to avoid KMS hot-paths.
Sam: metrics to add before canary: auth_p95_latency, auth_p99_latency, auth_5xx_rate, token_exchange_errors, shadow_mismatch_count, enforcement_401_rate. Dashboards + alerting thresholds required.
Jorge: backward-compat option: proxy issues ephemeral bearer token on first request for a legacy api-key and returns it in a response header; client unchanged but server auth flows use bearer token. Cache token keyed by api-key with TTL. Gradual TTL reduction during migration.
Priya: canary cohort idea: pick 3 orgs (small/med/large). run shadow + allow opt-in enforcement via console toggle. Provide migration checklist in console and templated emails.
policy-bot: Heads up: policy-schema-v2 merged to main 2 days ago. validation webhook available in staging.
Nina: action items: Ill draft migration playbook + RFC appendix; Sam: add dashboards/alerts; Alex: prototype caching/token-service; Jorge: build proxy shim; Priya: org comms + console UX.
Sam: rough timeline: 4 weeks for internal pilot if prioritized.
Nina: scheduling 30-min follow-up next week to lock dates. Thanks all :thumbsup:
